content.short: Drift is a Solana-powered decentralized trading protocol.
content.description: Drift is a decentralized trading protocol built for the Solana ecosystem. Traders can access perpetual swaps with leverage of up to 10x, enabling high-powered trading on a decentralized venue. Users can also borrow and lend blockchain assets to earn rewards within the protocol. Developers can leverage the Drift SDK to build trading bots or to retrieve historical market data for research and testing. The platform also includes built-in trading bots to assist traders in navigating markets.
